high_level_description: This image is a striking piece of architectural photography titled "Once on the Edge" by Yuanfeng Mao. The photograph captures a modern skyscraper at night, illuminated against the dark sky. The building features a unique design with a glass walkway extending outward from one of its corners, creating a dramatic silhouette. The walkway appears to be a viewing platform or observation deck, as it is filled with people standing and taking in the view. The lights inside the building are warm and inviting, contrasting with the cool blue lighting that outlines the structure's edges.
